search_surface: Maven Central Solr artifact search; targeted deps.dev and Maven Central release lookups

popularity_metric.name: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over all releases
popularity_metric.scope: Sum over every Maven release of deps.dev version-level directDependentCount; a dependent package is counted once per release it depends on. Incomplete public coverage. The single-release maximum and the default-release count are recorded beside it; the default-release count alone favours old single-release packages such as json-simple 1.1.1
